name: qm-companion
description: Self-hosted companion for the Quartermaster phone app. It provides service discovery, encrypted setup transfers and an optional Docker dashboard.

paths.name: Appdata
paths.description: Persistent encrypted state. Back up this directory and keep the same SECRET_KEY during upgrades.

paths.name: Radarr config
paths.description: Optional config.xml for a container named radarr. Add another read-only Path entry with a unique /stack/radarr-name/config.xml target for each extra instance.

paths.name: Sonarr config
paths.description: Optional config.xml for a container named sonarr. Add another read-only Path entry with a unique /stack/sonarr-name/config.xml target for each extra instance.

paths.name: Lidarr config
paths.description: Optional host path to Lidarr config.xml.

paths.name: Prowlarr config
paths.description: Optional host path to Prowlarr config.xml.

paths.name: Bazarr config
paths.description: Optional host path to Bazarr config.yaml.

paths.name: SABnzbd config
paths.description: Optional host path to SABnzbd sabnzbd.ini.

paths.name: Jellyseerr config
paths.description: Optional host path to Jellyseerr settings.json.

paths.name: Overseerr config
paths.description: Optional host path to Overseerr settings.json.

paths.name: Tautulli config
paths.description: Optional host path to Tautulli config.ini.

paths.name: Jackett config
paths.description: Optional host path to Jackett ServerConfig.json.

paths.name: NZBHydra2 config
paths.description: Optional host path to NZBHydra2 nzbhydra.yml.

ports.name: Web UI port
ports.description: Host port for the Companion web interface.

ports.name: Mobile HTTPS port
ports.description: Enter 8788 when enabling the persistent mobile connection. Leave blank while it is off.

variables.name: Encryption key
variables.description: 64 hexadecimal characters used to encrypt saved credentials. Generate it once with openssl rand -hex 32 and keep it for upgrades.

variables.name: Proxy key
variables.description: Key used to authenticate to qm-socket-proxy. Enter the same QM_PROXY_KEY used by the proxy template.

variables.name: Server address
variables.description: LAN or Tailscale address of this Unraid server that the phone can reach. Enter a host only, without a scheme, port or path.

variables.name: Away address
variables.description: Optional host name or Tailscale address suggested for away routes.

variables.name: Docker access limit
variables.description: Installed maximum: read, manage or shell. Keep read unless the proxy POST and EXEC settings are changed to match.

variables.name: Bind address
variables.description: Listener inside the container. Keep 0.0.0.0 for the Unraid port mapping.

variables.name: Docker host
variables.description: Internal qm-socket-proxy address. Keep this value unchanged and do not expose port 2375 on the host.

variables.name: Trusted reverse proxy
variables.description: Set true only when the panel is behind a trusted HTTPS reverse proxy.

variables.name: Persistent mobile connection
variables.description: Set true only after entering the Mobile HTTPS origin. Browser sign-in then moves from port 8787 to that direct HTTPS address.

variables.name: Allow new phone pairings
variables.description: Allows new pairings while the persistent mobile connection is enabled. Existing paired phones continue when this is false.

variables.name: Mobile HTTPS origin
variables.description: Exact direct LAN or Tailscale origin reached by phones, including https:// and :8788. Reverse-proxy addresses are not supported.

variables.name: Mobile listener port
variables.description: Internal HTTPS listener port. Keep this at 8788 so it matches the Mobile HTTPS port and origin.

variables.name: Mobile bind address
variables.description: Listener inside the container. Keep 0.0.0.0 for the Unraid port mapping.

variables.name: Marketplace bind roots
variables.description: Optional host roots allowed for Marketplace bind mounts. Leave blank to allow named volumes only.

variables.name: Marketplace bind address
variables.description: Optional host address used for ports published by Marketplace deployments.
